parts:
Dear all,

We are pleased to announce the online course “Markov and Hidden Markov Models in R.”

 

Dates: 19-22 January 2027

 

Course website: www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/markov-and-hidden-markov-models-with-applications-in-r/ 

 

 

The course introduces the foundations and practical applications of Markov and hidden Markov models for longitudinal data. Participants will learn how to specify, estimate, and interpret these models, including extensions for covariates and continuous, categorical, and incomplete responses.

 

The training combines methodological lectures with hands-on exercises in R using the LMest package, making it suitable for researchers, students, and industry professionals interested in analysing longitudinal data. Basic familiarity with R is helpful but not required.

 

 

Please feel free to share this announcement with interested colleagues.

Best regards,

 

Carlo
